arguments.value: Edward Milton Chen, born in 1953 in Oakland, California, is a United States District Judge for the Northern District of California, where he has served since his confirmation in 2011 and assumed senior status in 2022. He previously served as a United States Magistrate Judge for the same court from 2001 to 2011. A graduate of the University of California, Berkeley, Chen earned his A.B. in 1975 and his J.D. from Berkeley Law in 1979. His early legal career included clerkships with Judge Charles B. Renfrew of the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California and Judge James R. Browning of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, followed by work with the Asian Law Caucus, private practice in San Francisco, and service as a staff attorney with the American Civil Liberties Union Foundation of Northern California.
